name: What should I do to prepare for a water heater replacement?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare for a water heater replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a water heater replacement, ensure the area around your existing unit is clear and accessible for technicians. You might want to clear a pathway from the entry point to the installation site. Consider your hot water usage needs and preferences in advance, as this will help the plumbing team recommend the most suitable replacement. If you have any specific concerns about noise, space, or energy efficiency, have these questions ready. CG Plumbing Solutions will manage the draining and disconnection of the old unit, but having the area ready helps streamline the process and ensures a quicker, smoother installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the area around the unit, consider your hot water needs, and have questions ready. This helps streamline the replacement process.
